title: Previous refusal declared

intake.other_travel_details: Previous UK visit application refused three years ago; declared here.

documents.label: Bank statement
lines: Institution status: regulated bank; a financial institution permitted for visa funds; keeps all records electronically
Days between the closing balance date and the application date: 11

paragraphs: I applied for a UK visit visa three years ago and it was refused because my documents were incomplete. I am applying again with full evidence.
I will visit for one week for a friend's graduation and I will return to my job at the end.

label.rationale: Guidance 7.2 (previous immigration history) makes a declared past refusal a factor to weigh; nothing in the kept rules makes it an objective failure.

purpose: A declared previous refusal: expected to be weighed as a concern at most, never a refusal ground.
